name: CCR4-NOT transcription complex subunit 9

function.text: CNOT9 is the approved symbol for CCR4-NOT transcription complex subunit 9. Reviewed functional annotations implicate its product in epidermal growth factor receptor binding; kinase binding; negative regulation of intracellular estrogen receptor signaling pathway.

germline.text: No conflict-free strong or definitive constitutional disease relationship met the source-selection criteria for this draft; this does not exclude a germline association.

somatic.text: Cancer Hotspots v1 reports recurrent residue-level observations in Bladder urothelial carcinoma; Hepatocellular carcinoma; Prostate adenocarcinoma. This is statistical recurrence evidence; it does not establish that every variant in this gene is a driver or a clinically actionable alteration. Evidence in this collection is restricted to the historical V1 release.

function.text: CNOT9 encodes CCR4-NOT transcription complex subunit 9. Based in part on similarity, it forms part of the CCR4-NOT complex which is one of the major cellular mRNA deadenylases and is linked to various cellular processes including bulk mRNA degradation, miRNA-mediated repression, translational repression during translational initiation and general transcription regulation. Additional complex functions may be a consequence of its influence on mRNA expression. It participates in down-regulation of MYB- and JUN-dependent transcription.

somatic.text: Somatic alterations involving CNOT9 have been reported in cutaneous melanoma, gastric adenocarcinoma, and prostate adenocarcinoma.
